exposure: Diagnosis of an unusual variation of vasa previa with velamentous cord insertion
outcome: Identification and characterization of an atypical vasa previa variant
cohort: A 27-year-old primigravida woman whose condition was diagnosed during her second-trimester obstetric sonographic examination.
finding: An unusual variation of vasa previa was identified, in which a single fetal vessel separated from a membranous insertion near the fundal placenta and traversed posteriorly through the chorionic membrane to within 0.83 cm of the internal os.
